cues.en: So the probability is defined by, you know, my operatory knowledge about the real world.
cues.zh: 機率是由我對真實世界的先驗知識決定。

cues.en: How many of these different marbles there are?
cues.zh: 也就是這些不同彈珠各有多少顆。

cues.en: And the proportion is just however the experiment happened to work out.
cues.zh: 比例則只是這次實驗剛好得到的結果。

cues.en: So we can run this code again, and now we get a different, still a mismatch between the proportion and probability.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，就會得到不同結果，比例和機率之間仍然有差異。

cues.en: They're not exactly the same, although this one looks really close, but it's totally different.
cues.zh: 雖然這個看起來非常接近，但仍然不同，而且這次結果也完全不同。

cues.en: Every time you rerun this code, the probabilities will stay exactly the same, but the proportions are going to change from run to run.
cues.zh: 每次重新執行，機率都完全相同，但比例會隨每次執行而改變。

cues.en: All right, so what I encourage you to do now as just a little bit of a extra learning exercise is to change this numDraws parameter.
cues.zh: 好，作為額外的小練習，我鼓勵你改變 numDraws 參數。

cues.en: So change the number of marbles that you're drawing from this jar.
cues.zh: 也就是改變從罐子抽取的彈珠數量。

cues.en: Now you don't have to do this really quantitatively, you don't have to do this rigorously.
cues.zh: 不用非常定量，也不用很嚴謹。

cues.en: And you know, with like big data analysis running on a cluster server somewhere, just kind of randomly poke around and do it qualitatively.
cues.zh: 不需要在某個叢集伺服器上執行大型資料分析，只要隨意嘗試，進行定性觀察。

cues.en: So you can try, for example, running this experiment with 50 marbles.
cues.zh: 例如，可以試著抽 50 顆彈珠。

cues.en: You can try with 5,000 marbles.
cues.zh: 也可以試 5000 顆。

cues.en: You can try various numbers.
cues.zh: 可以嘗試各種數量。

cues.en: And the idea is to explore the closeness of the proportion with probability as a function of the number of marbles that you're drawing from this jar.
cues.zh: 目的是探索，比例和機率的接近程度，如何隨從罐子抽出的彈珠數量改變。

cues.en: Again, just do this qualitatively just poking around a little bit.
cues.zh: 同樣地，只要稍微嘗試，定性觀察即可。

cues.en: And the question is, are these two values going to be closer when you have fewer marbles to draw or are they gonna be closer to each other when you have more marbles to draw?
cues.zh: 問題是，抽取的彈珠比較少時，這兩個值會比較接近，還是抽得比較多時更接近？

cues.en: Or you know, is it sort of always gonna be random?
cues.zh: 或者，其實總是隨機的？

cues.en: Even when you draw more and more marbles, you're always gonna see these discrepancies between the proportion and probability.
cues.zh: 即使抽取越來越多顆，仍然總會看到比例和機率之間的差異？

cues.en: So it's an empirical question for you to explore.
cues.zh: 這是留給你探索的實驗問題。
